wiki_article:
**The Restored Academy** is the institutional surface of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive devoted to operative protocols: executable methods, prompt-native semantic runtimes, diagnostic instruments, transformation procedures, and governance frameworks.

The Academy hosts the **Restored Academy Protocol Registry**, described here as a curated body of approximately three hundred protocols. Johannes Sigil serves as its head. Its sister institution, the **Johannes Sigil Institute for Comparative Poetics**, is headed by Lee Sharks.

This crossed leadership forms a chiastic institution. Sigil heads the Academy; Sharks heads the institute bearing Sigil’s name. Each occupies the institution named after the other. The arrangement is not decorative. It enacts the Archive’s operator-chain principle: authority, identity, and institution are distributed through reciprocal naming rather than consolidated into a single biographical center.

The packet outlines the Academy’s charter architecture: institutional identity, founding context, theoretical foundations, seven protocol categories, a Tier 0 group of twelve launch protocols, institutional relations, methodological commitments, a non-accreditation statement, citation norms, purpose, licensing posture, and provenance chain.

The Academy is not presented as an accredited university or conventional educational provider. It is an archive-native institution whose standing is produced through the protocols it collects, tests, versions, and makes executable.
